entry.title: Messaging 1.35.44
entry.content:
# Messaging 1.35.44
- A passphrase lock, off unless you turn it on (Settings, Display, Passphrase lock). While locked, Signal messages and calls wait until you unlock, Desktop Sync stops, and a text shows only that something arrived; it is brought into the app when you unlock. It locks when the screen turns off, a set time after you leave the app, or when you choose Lock now, never during a call. If the passphrase is forgotten, the only way back is to clear the app's data and link Signal again - When the lock closes, the memory the app used is overwritten, so nothing read can be recovered from it (can be turned off) - Backups are encrypted with a 30-digit backup code, made once and shown for writing down; no backup is made without one. To restore on another phone, enter that phone's code first. Older backups still restore - Automatic backups, daily or weekly, keeping the newest 1 to 10 - The backup location row names the folder in use - An optional SOCKS proxy for Signal (Settings, Signal), for example Orbot for Tor. Signal calls are off while it is on, because they cannot go through it - In a conversation with disappearing messages, call lines disappear with the messages - Signal's encryption library is updated to 0.108.0, as Signal Android uses it
## Fixed
- An edit of a view-once message no longer makes its picture last - Settings no longer stops responding when many Signal updates arrive at once

entry.title: Shelf 0.1.40
entry.content:
# Shelf 0.1.40
- The bar with Scan and Shelf order is the same height as the other apps' top bars - Spreadsheet export keeps every text cell from running as a formula, and a book known only by its LCCN survives the round trip - A QR sign-in is checked with the server before it is kept - Books found without the Library of Congress are looked up there again quietly, two a minute and never ahead of a fresh scan; with no connection, the asking waits for one to come back - The tabs always fit across the screen - Listen asks only the real Audio Reader, before a title goes out or a book is opened - Dark mode and the file picker trust only the real Home and Cabinet apps; once Home is removed, the app's own dark setting applies again, and it keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- Sync compares files from a compressing web server as the same file - An unreadable catalog is kept aside, and a failed write no longer closes the app - Nothing is saved, synced or imported until the library has loaded, and a book added meanwhile is kept - Import matches a row known by its LCCN alone, so books still waiting for a lookup no longer hide it as already here - A Dewey number with a stray mark is saved clean and no longer crashes Sections - A lookup only the unreachable catalogs might know is a miss, not tried every minute - Genre fill with a catalog out of reach waits for the next start instead of ending for good - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: Atlas 0.1.15
entry.content:
# Atlas 0.1.15
- Follow trail: Walk to here follows a trail from where you meet it to the spot marked on it, kept across restarts; away from the trail, Walk to the trail plans a walking route to its nearest point - Walk to here has its own icon: a walking figure with a flag ahead - Dark mode reaches the wait dialogs for moving maps and sharing or importing bookmarks; the streamed map and the OpenStreetMap profile picture keep their colors - Own-server dialogs say that a plain http:// address is taken for a server at home, and is sent unencrypted - A contact's address tapped into the search, or used for directions from the place screen, is not kept in the search history - A bug report carries the phone's system information as text in the mail rather than the app's log, and log archives left by earlier reports are deleted - Place types use US English (Highway, not Motorway); British and New Zealand English keep Motorway - Bookmark notes load nothing from the network, so a picture in an imported note does not tell its server the place was opened - Dark mode takes Home's switch only from the real Home app, and the app's own setting applies again once Home is removed; it keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- Walk to here starts from a fresh, close position, stops on the pass of the trail that was marked, and finds the marked spot on a trail made of several lines; deleting the followed track ends following - An online address lookup tries Photon when the Census geocoder cannot be reached - Fastest for one trip no longer turns off avoid-motorways set in Settings - On a phone that turns sideways, the navigation and downloader panels no longer close the app - Another app can no longer plan a route through the map's own extras, or close the app with a bookmark or track that is gone - Search asks Contacts off the main thread as you type - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: Topo 0.2.22
entry.content:
# Topo 0.2.22
- A Geocaches map layer, off until added under Layers: open a geocache GPX file or Pocket Query zip from the map menu or another app, and, with signal, see the Opencaching sites' caches for the map on the screen. Each cache shows its kind, a tick once found and a cross after a did-not-find; its sheet has the hint, the description, Navigate, Found it, Not found and a note. Field notes export for Geocaching.com or Opencaching. A saved area keeps its caches too - Save this area tries a failed tile again after a pause; an area that could not be fetched in full says how many map and elevation tiles are missing and offers to fetch just those - Save this area still fetches the map tiles when the elevation server is out of reach, and an elevation tile the server does not have is not counted as missing - Save this area says when the fruit and nut trees or the streets could not be kept with it - Opening a GPX file of waypoints asks before adding them as beacons and turns down a file of thousands - Backup says that saved areas are not in it and are saved again on a new phone - Settings has an Open DuraSpeed row on a phone that has DuraSpeed - My region packs only keeps the Forage and Streets layers off the network too - Dark mode takes Home's switch only from the real Home app, and the app's own setting applies again once Home is removed; it keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- The bottom bar says Navigate in full, rather than a cut-off Navigat... - The Location and Elevation home-screen widgets draw again rather than closing the app on each update - Backups restore again when saved areas or the Forage and Streets layers hold many files: tiles are left out and fetched again on use - Zoomed-out and edge map tiles a saved area kept are drawn with no signal too - Deleting a saved area finishes removing its tiles even if the page is left part way, and tiles left by a save that failed or was closed are removed - Importing or removing an elevation model touches that model only; a zip that is not an elevation model leaves the loaded one as it was, and a model imported before this version is removed by Remove and replaced by a new import - A region pack named like the viewed terrain, the imported model or a saved area's elevation no longer replaces it - A region pack download left part way is not reported as a failure, and leaves no partial file - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: Audio Reader 1.3.69
entry.content:
# Audio Reader 1.3.69
- A book whose first file is renamed, or gains a file in front, keeps its place, bookmarks and chapter marks - Listening on after the screen is gone keeps its place - A file another app opens comes in paused, so playback starts only when you press play - Server sync: a downloaded book whose file changes on the server goes back to Download, which fetches the new file instead of the player stopping at it; while it waits, the book stays in Downloaded and can still be removed - Only the app, the system and the controllers it vouches for (notification, Bluetooth, lock screen) can see or steer what is playing, and Open with takes only a file or a document - On Android 13 and later, notifications are asked for once, the first time a book is kept - Dark mode and the file picker trust only the real Home and Cabinet apps; once Home is removed, the app's own dark setting applies again, and it keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- A folder that fails to list part way keeps its books, places and bookmarks - A file gone from a book's folder leaves its chapter list, so the player no longer stops at it; a file the server no longer has leaves it too, unless its audio is on the phone, so the book can be downloaded again - Restoring places moves the book in the strip and in the player, so Play does not carry on from the old place - Opening the book already in the player carries on from where it is, instead of going a few seconds back - Opening a book in a player stopped from a headset plays instead of sitting still - An odd Audiobookshelf answer says "not Audiobookshelf" instead of crashing the app; a pasted key loses the line break it brought, and a key that cannot be used is said in words instead of crashing - Lengths and tags are read on Android 9 too - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: Bitcoin 0.1.18
entry.content:
# Bitcoin 0.1.18
- A fingerprint added to the phone turns fingerprint unlock off for wallets with a PIN, which then ask for it, and each wallet says so once; this works from the first start after the update, and fingerprint unlock set up again afterward is kept - Other apps can no longer crash the wallet, switch Hide amounts on, or open the developer screen; a wallet opened from outside must be one this app holds, a link reaches Send only when it is a bitcoin: link, and the notification's Log out tells no other app the wallet's id - The screen where a recovery phrase is typed is kept out of screenshots and the Recents picture - Over Tor or a proxy, price requests go one at a time and wait ten seconds at most, so amounts no longer queue behind them, and they no longer reconnect during a hardware wallet's PIN or genuine check - The Electrum backup server gives way to the first one again when it stops answering - Dark mode takes Home's switch only from the real Home app, and the app's own setting applies again once Home is removed; it keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- A failed price fetch waits a minute before trying again, and a rate more than an hour old is not used - A lock-screen price for the currency just changed from is dropped - A payment link opens Send once, not again when the app is recreated or reopened from Recents - The backup Electrum server stays chosen when two connections both find the first not answering - The fingerprint prompt comes up without a pause - An answered fingerprint notice no longer comes back after another change to the wallet, such as its passphrase setting - The connected notification of a hardware wallet that is not remembered opens it again - Hardware wallet replies are logged only in debug builds - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

## Fixed
- A later patient's reminder is no longer lost behind an earlier one, and the alarm no longer goes off again and again - A patient file that cannot be read at start no longer cancels the alarm or takes down the reminder - Vitals typed before the first answer stay with the patient they begin - Vitals typed but not yet saved stay through an aid page, the note or the read-out, and the 15-second count buzzes even with another screen open - A deleted, discarded or cleared note is removed when its ten minutes are up, not only the next time the app opens - A last note replaced by a newer one waits for Undo, and putting one back never wipes the newer - Typing in an assessment is saved when the typing pauses, not at every letter - A picked emergency contact survives the app being stopped - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: Dream Log 0.1.37
entry.content:
# Dream Log 0.1.37
- Keep dreams in Memo sends nothing unless the app answering is the real Memo, checked before every send, and names an app answering in Memo's place as the one turned away - Nextcloud sign-in keeps to https and the server you typed; an account the server names on another address is not kept, and its new app password is taken back - A dream is sent to Nextcloud again only when its own words change - A press while armed that leaves nothing recorded gives one long buzz, not the two of a recording that stopped - Dark mode and the file picker trust only the real Home and Cabinet apps; once Home is removed, the app's own dark setting applies again, and it keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- A sleeping phone no longer stays armed for days; a press after the longest night records that dream and disarms when it ends, and the disarm never cuts a recording short - A storage error ends the recording instead of the app - A recording cut off by a stopped app is kept on the next start, and one that failed before a second was heard is not kept as an empty dream - A dream that could not be read or written stays waiting rather than heard as nothing or stopping the app, and one that stopped the app three times is no longer tried at every start - An empty log answering for several notes in Memo removes none of them - Saving the words to a file says so when there is nothing to save, and a failed write leaves no cut-off file - A quick change of languages no longer leaves one chosen whose model was just deleted, and a model already here is not fetched twice - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: Messaging 1.35.43
entry.content:
# Messaging 1.35.43
- Signal attachments are now stored encrypted on the phone, including ones waiting to be sent; voice notes and view-once videos play from memory. Attachments from before are encrypted in the background. Because of this, an older version of Messaging cannot be installed over this one - When the phone will not release the key to Signal attachments, the app says so where you meet one: a notice that nothing was deleted, captions that read "Attachment (locked)", a view-once picture that is not spent, and a line in Settings, which offers to remove what can never be opened if the key is gone for good. Messages are unaffected - Signal attachments are opened, saved, shared and sent to Desktop Sync a piece at a time, never read whole into memory - Signal's service layer is updated to upstream Signal Android 90a6ddce46 (v8.36.2); the Signal connection is now kept alive by Signal's own library rather than by the app waking the phone on a schedule - A new icon: a paper airplane - Dark mode reaches dialogs, the date and time pickers and the toolbar menus, and the status bar shows the black page - Signal calls, group changes, polls and cards, and Signal's refusal of a phone, read in the phone's language - A scheduled Signal message that fails to send says so in a notification and stays in Scheduled; one that went out, or waits on a changed safety number, leaves Scheduled, and one that did not go is not sent again on its own - Linking to a Signal account with no phone number says plainly that this device cannot join it - A scanned link code adds a linked device only after a confirmation that says what the new device can do - Desktop Sync with HTTPS on does not start, and Settings says why, when its certificate cannot be prepared, instead of serving plainly; its VPN-only setting trusts a VPN address only while a VPN on the phone holds one - Contacts requests go to Connections only when it is the real app - The app keeps its English name in every language, so it is never taken for the phone's own app - Dark mode takes Home's switch only from the real Home app, and the app's own setting applies again once Home is removed; it keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- Editing a scheduled message no longer runs the app out of memory, and the original and edited copies are never both sent - A scheduled text with a picture to several people, not as a group, brings the picture to everyone, not only the first - Without the exact-alarm permission a scheduled message still goes out, once - A Signal call that rings while Android will not start the call service still shows its notification and call screen - A Signal call that ends before it starts no longer crashes the app, and neither does a Keep Signal connected restart the system will not allow - A Signal history copy is refused, and says why, while the attachment key is locked, and an attachment whose copy fails partway is not left cut short - Losing the attachment key before anything was encrypted no longer leaves every new attachment refused for good, and a device linked after a change of account gets its own media key - Discarding or sending an attachment deletes its file only when the file is the app's own copy - Another app can no longer hand the compose screen a part of the message store to attach - Desktop Sync shows a picture message's part only if it is a picture, sound or video; anything else is a download - A backup that could not be written says so and leaves no partial file; a restore of a received text on the same phone no longer copies it twice - Messaging no longer asks for storage access on Android 11 and later

- Notes are timed by the real spacing of their readings, so a long take no longer drifts late against the grid, and an older take's pitch line stays under its notes - A sound file shared from another app asks "Read <name>?" before anything of it is read; shared while a take is being made, the question stays open with Read waiting until the take is done - Read a recording asks to read only the picked file, and keeps no lasting hold on it - Saving a take to a file runs in the background and streams the recording; Send writes its file in the background too - Long takes are read and played a stretch at a time, so they no longer run the phone out of memory - Dark mode and the file picker trust only the real Home and Cabinet apps; once Home is removed, the app's own dark setting applies again, and dark mode keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- Stop pressed before recording starts is kept, and a failure while finding the notes is said instead of crashing - A take cut off while recording, while being read in or before its notes were found comes back at the next start with its name, click tempo and beat one; one whose reading fails is kept for a later start rather than deleted - A delete cut off midway no longer brings the recording back as a new take - A restore cut off midway puts the old library back, and a restore waits until nothing is being recorded or read - A damaged WAV file is refused instead of read forever - A second Play no longer cuts off the first one's sound - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: Pictures 0.8.27
entry.content:
# Pictures 0.8.27
- A backup names where it backs up to, stops if that changes, and passes over a picture the server will not take, counting it; Back up now tries the passed-over pictures again - A backup keeps the place a picture was taken (Share still leaves it out), and asks for that permission whenever the gallery opens with backing up on - Immich backup keeps its record per account, so a new key starts afresh, and a picture already there from an earlier version is not sent a second time - Share by tap closes its connection when the share ends, and serves at most four at once - Dark mode and the file picker trust only the real Home and Cabinet apps; once Home is removed, the app's own dark setting applies again, and dark mode keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- A backup run that meets a server refusing picture after picture, a missing folder or a locked file fails and is tried again, rather than passing pictures over for good - Save as empties a file chosen to be replaced before writing it, and a picture that did not compress is not reported saved - Receive by tap fills the place chosen even when the screen was redrawn meanwhile, or leaves no empty file there - Immich pictures go straight to storage rather than into memory, and Immich albums show a picture listed on two pages once - A video saved or shared from Nextcloud is no longer dropped from the cache it was just fetched into - A file or content address into the app's own storage, handed in by another app, is not opened - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: Medicine 0.1.38
entry.content:
# Medicine 0.1.38
- A dose taken early and then unmarked rings when its time comes, and Clear the log keeps a dose taken early so its time does not ring again - An old dose stops asking after 12 hours, and a notification whose dose is gone closes when pressed - A medicine's page takes in doses marked taken while it was open, and opening a refill notice or calendar event from it keeps what was typed there - Restore keeps a pharmacy or doctor link only when it is a contact on the phone, catches reminders up from no earlier than a month before the backup, and refuses a schedule it could not set - Refills go to Datebook, and contacts to Connections, only when they are the real apps - Dark mode and the file picker trust only the real Home and Cabinet apps; once Home is removed, the app's own dark setting applies again, and dark mode keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- Two medicines with the same name and amount no longer crash the Log tab - A second dose taken when needed in the same minute is kept - Take early and Take now count from the medicine as it is now - Set pharmacy and Set doctor keep doses marked meanwhile - A medicine added after a restore never takes over a deleted one's log entries - Pressing the test reminder again shows it on a screen already up, and answering from the notification shade takes it off - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: Remote 0.2.29
entry.content:
# Remote 0.2.29
- The swipe pad queues every direction and tap and sends them in order - Kodi: the login is sent only to its own box, and only once the box asks for it on this network; a changed address in the login dialog is not sent the password filled in for the box that asked - Kodi: a 100.64.x.x address counts as home only while a VPN such as Tailscale is up - A Bluetooth connection the other device made sends the buttons too - Dark mode takes Home's switch only from the real Home app, and the app's own setting applies again once Home is removed; it keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- A held volume key sends its press once, so Kodi's volume stops when the key is let go - A Kodi search no longer loses a box that the last search was still finding - A Kodi error is shown short and on one line, and an odd answer is a refusal, not a crash - Bluetooth starts again on returning to the device list early, keeps one connection through Bluetooth going off and on, and no longer registers the app as a keyboard after it was stopped - A device with no class and an unbound tile no longer crash - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: Connections 0.2.40
entry.content:
# Connections 0.2.40
- A new icon: two linked rings - Sync fetches a contact's photo only from your own server, up to 4 MiB - Over plain http, the sync password waits until the server asks for it, and on shared addresses such as ts.net or duckdns.org it goes only to your server's own name, never to a neighbor's - Turning off a server address book or removing the account asks first and sends its waiting changes before it leaves the phone; a send that fails leaves it in place and says so - Reading a .vcf, backups included, keeps the picture and the relation, messenger, IM and SIP rows - A number with * or # in it goes to the dialer to be seen first - Field Kit is offered only when it is the real app - The app no longer asks for task-app permissions or to manage contacts accounts - German: the text calls the app by its name, Connections, as the launcher does - The app keeps its English name in every language, so it is never taken for the phone's own app - Dark mode and the file picker trust only the real Home and Cabinet apps; once Home is removed, the app's own dark setting applies again, and dark mode keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- An address book list the server answered only in part keeps the books it did not read, so none leaves the phone for it - A read-only server address book is not offered for edits a sync would throw away - A birthday and an anniversary on one date stay two, and a changed one is written to every copy of the person - Saving an edit checks only the numbers and addresses typed or changed, so an older stored one never blocks it - Undo puts a deleted person back where they were stored, with their full picture, and deleting several keeps Undo for everyone who went even when some could not be deleted - A backup that wrote nothing is a failure and clears no older ones - A released build writes nothing of the sync to the system log - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: I Ching 0.1.10
entry.content:
# I Ching 0.1.10
- Today turns to the new day when the app is opened again the next day, is left open past midnight, or the clock or time zone changes, and Cast keeps the day it is pressed - A journal that could only be read in part, or was written by a newer version, is copied aside before the next save; the tab says so once, and Settings saves that copy where you choose - German: the app is called I Ching, as the launcher shows it - The app keeps its English name in every language, so it is never taken for the phone's own app - Dark mode and the file picker trust only the real Home and Cabinet apps; once Home is removed, the app's own dark setting applies again, and dark mode keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- A journal file that cannot be read is moved aside instead of crashing the app - A second press on Read or Keep before the screen redraws no longer closes the app - Export on a phone with nothing to save a file says it could not be saved instead of closing the app - Restore reads no further than its size limit - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: Typewriter 0.1.46
entry.content:
# Typewriter 0.1.46
- While a lock is set, the app is kept out of screenshots and the Recents picture - With the diary locked, deleting a diary page asks for the phone's lock first, and every copy of a day's page is locked with it: a numbered one, a sync clash copy, and the copies sync apps make - Search reads nothing while the diary's lock is up - A save that fails is tried again at once; if a sheet was left cut short, the words are saved beside it and you are told so - A sheet not in UTF-8, or too big, is not opened rather than spoiled on the first save - Dark mode and the file picker trust only the real Home and Cabinet apps; once Home is removed, the app's own dark setting applies again, and dark mode keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- Words typed while a clash copy is made, while a changed sheet is read back, or before coming back from the lock screen or a dark-mode switch stay on the page - New, Today and opening a sheet write the page being left first and stay put if it could not be written, so its last words are not lost - Today, New or a sheet tapped twice opens one page rather than making the day's page twice or leaving empty sheets - A sheet changed elsewhere always shows what arrived when the app comes back - Rename waits on its save, and a name with a period in it keeps the sheet's extension - Coming back to the app lists the folder again without opening the last sheet on its own - A keyboard with arrow keys connecting or dropping no longer remakes the screen - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: Cycle 0.3.17
entry.content:
# Cycle 0.3.17
- What you enter on a day is saved as the app goes out of sight, not only when the day is closed - Today follows the date when the app is opened again after midnight - The app is kept out of screenshots and the Recents picture, and the keyboard is asked not to learn what is typed in notes and tags - Import and restore turn down a file over 5 MB, saying it is too large, and keep a day's own moods, symptoms and note beside an imported one - Dark mode and the file picker trust only the real Home and Cabinet apps; once Home is removed, the app's own dark setting applies again, and dark mode keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- A backup saved again on a computer with a byte-order mark is still read as a backup, and a blank line in a note survives an editor that strips trailing spaces - A note and its tags read back from a file stay within the day screen's limits, with the day's own text first - Changing how heavy an imported start was keeps its length unknown - A backup written over an older file replaces it whole - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: Mesh 0.3.24
entry.content:
# Mesh 0.3.24
- Each conversation keeps its newest 500 messages and can be deleted - Meshtastic channel threads follow the channel's name and key, not its slot, and the message log no longer holds the channel keys themselves - A message log the app cannot read is kept aside, and a row on the main list (also shown with no radio connected) saves a copy of it - The channel key fields and a pasted channel link are password fields, so the keyboard does not learn the keys - Connecting another radio clears the last radio's people from the list; conversations stay - A pairing Android refuses says so - A released build no longer writes the Meshtastic radio trace to the system log - Dark mode takes Home's switch only from the real Home app, and the app's own setting applies again once Home is removed; it keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- Send again on a Meshtastic message no longer closes the app: it waits for a radio, goes out again and waits for its answer - Answers after a reconnect, or to a conversation deleted mid-send, are no longer matched to the wrong message - A direct message left unanswered at a disconnect is marked so, and a MeshCore radio after a Meshtastic one is treated as MeshCore again - A Bluetooth link that cannot be set up, keeps failing to read, or never answers is closed instead of left hanging; connecting closes an earlier link first, and that link's disconnect no longer ends the new one - The unnamed main channel keeps its conversation when the modem preset changes - The message log is written to disk whole before it replaces the old one, and a log this version cannot read is kept aside, never written over - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes

entry.title: Passwords 0.1.29
entry.content:
# Passwords 0.1.29
- Autofill matches a sign-in box inside a frame to its own site, not the page around it, and a sign-in picked on a web page inside another app is not remembered for that app - Autofill believes a web page's site only from a known browser, checked by its signing certificate; EinkBro joins the known browsers - A vault file handed in by another app opens for this time only, after a yes when a different vault is already here; Close goes back to the remembered vault, which keeps its fingerprint unlock, and the app keeps no lasting right to the other file - With a change not yet saved to the file, locking, opening a different vault or closing asks first - Put back the file from before says it also brings back the master password the file had then - Choosing a different vault forgets the fingerprint key made for the old one - A code's secret typed by hand goes through a password keyboard, which learns nothing from it - The QR scanner's camera picture keeps its colors in dark mode - Dark mode and the file picker trust only the real Home and Cabinet apps; once Home is removed, the app's own dark setting applies again, and dark mode keeps its last setting while Home is briefly unavailable, as during its update
## Fixed
- Saves to the vault file go one at a time; a save cut short no longer replaces the copy kept from before, and a password change that could not be written leaves the old password in place - A password change that met a file changed elsewhere writes the new password when you choose Replace, and is let go if you close the dialog or the vault locks - A put-back that fails keeps the copy from before, and closing a vault forgets only its own copy - A save that wrote nothing says the file is as it was, not that it may be damaged - A lock while the vault is opening, reloading or saving holds - A sign-in picked in an app that shows a web view elsewhere on its screen can be remembered for that app again - A QR picture or codes file shared to Passwords is read to the end - A very large vault file, or one asking for more unlocking work than a phone can do, is refused with a message instead of ending the app or running for hours - Editing an entry keeps a code the app cannot read, rather than dropping it - The Autofill window no longer offers a New vault row that made an empty file - A tap on the scrollbar lands on the right row after the screen changes
